name: PT Intra Golflink Resorts Tbk
summary: PT Intra Golflink Resorts Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, owns, develops, and manages golf courses in Indonesia. The company operates through four segments: Golf, Restaurant, Real Estate, and Others. It engages in management consultation; real estate business; and restoration and land management cooperation. The company was formerly known as PT Dreamland Pecatu Golf and changed its name to PT Intra Golflink Resorts Tbk in October 2005. PT Intra Golflink Resorts Tbk was founded in 2005 and is based in Bogor, Indonesia. The company operates as a subsidiary of PT Bali Pecatu Graha.
